hypothesis_zh: 盐晶面材质供体经多种子稳健残差，只进入四颗程序晶体 region 后，可增加晶面层次且不改变数量、轮廓、液体或质量关系。
single_variable_zh: 相对程序底图只增加模型派生的受限中高频晶面材质；四颗晶体身份、边界、液体和背景不变。

prompt_parts.scene_identity: Extreme macro material photograph of uniform translucent sodium chloride crystal surface, edge-to-edge sample
prompt_parts.material_goal: fine crystalline facets, subtle mineral sparkle, restrained highlights, low-contrast translucent texture
prompt_parts.state_delta: uniform material swatch without separate crystal objects
prompt_parts.must_preserve: even texture scale, no large edges, no text

negative_artifacts: separate crystals, crystal pile, cubes, gemstones, jewelry, rocks, salt shaker, cracks, giant facets, dividing lines, panels, objects, hands, text, labels, arrows, user interface, watermark, plastic, metal, perspective, blur
